summary: Added and executed new vesper-native coverage for requested major flows: StreamRepository ordering/security, BrowseRepository routes/parsing/failure paths, CatalogRepository tmdb->imdb->meta detail resolution, new Robolectric coverage for Browse/Directory/Anime/ExitDialog/StreamScreen/DetailScreen/PlayerActivity/LocalPreferences/layout breakpoints. Native unit suite and assembleDebug pass.

integration_issues.issue: apksigner verify still reports v1 scheme=false while v2=true for debug APK, despite requested v1+v2 enabling.

action_items: Fix APK signing config/tooling so apksigner shows both v1=true and v2=true for produced debug artifact.
Keep new native tests in regression suite; do not remove existing Keystore hardware-bound skip (pre-existing).
After signing fix, rerun :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug and re-verify with /usr/bin/apksigner and /usr/bin/zipalign -c 4.
critical_code_review_comments: StreamRepository now has explicit regression coverage for source cascade ordering, uncached demotion, URL sanitization, and proxy header hardening (Host/CRLF filtering).
Browse/Catalog read-only route behavior is now covered including AU region propagation, tmdb title mapping, genres/anime rails parsing, and no fabricated fallback data on 500/invalid JSON.
ExitDialog lifecycle and Back semantics are covered; movie/series Back returns to Home instead of app-exit path.
PlayerActivity tests validate release lifecycle via reflection, config-cycle survival, and intent guard behavior without claiming physical decoder support.
Certificate SHA-256 digest is unchanged vs previous-signature.txt; only v1 verification remains failing.

success_rate.frontend: 97.5% (native JVM suite pass with existing 1 hardware-bound skip; assembleDebug pass)

rca of the issue: Signing gate issue reproduces consistently: build succeeds and certificate digest remains unchanged, but apksigner verify reports v1=false/v2=true. Likely packaging/signing config path still not emitting JAR signature block for debug artifact or signing config not applied as expected to produced variant.
